identity.title: Pokémon Quiz Puzzle Land: Pikachu Exploration Team

leadText:
----
(Japanese: Pokémon Quiz Puzzle Land: Pikachu Exploration Team) is a Pokémon manga composed by Hiroshi Takase and illustrated by Kemon Kawamoto. It was serialized in the magazine from the issue 66 (released on November 30, 2019) to the issue 81 (released on November 30, 2022). The manga utilizes quizzes and puzzles as a method of storytelling. It is 168 pages long.
